title: Queen of the Underworld
description: A crowned female figure in a long black gown stands within a massive circular metal portal, holding an orange glowing chain. Behind her is a dark gothic castle, cracked fiery ground, barren trees, and a ghostly spectral face in the sky. The portal is surrounded by purple and blue flowers, dripping orange liquid, and floating train cars against a black background with blue ethereal smoke above.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a crowned queen in a flowing black gown holding an orange glowing chain, standing inside a large circular rusty metal frame. Behind her is a gothic castle on cracked fiery ground with barren trees. A ghostly spectral face floats in the black sky. Purple and blue flowers grow around the portal, orange liquid drips from the bottom, and ghostly blue smoke with floating train cars appears above. Dramatic lighting, intricate details.
